sms.title: A discreet proposition
sms.text:
V. Lieutenant Mara Voss, NCPD.
I've been following your recent work. Impressive, though I doubt the department would approve of all your methods.
I have a proposition for you. Something I'd rather discuss in person.
I've sent you a location. Come alone, and keep this between us.
— Lt. Mara Voss

conversation.speaker: voss
conversation.text: V. Glad you could make it. Lieutenant Mara Voss, NCPD. I've been going through your recent scanner reports. You've been rather busy. Some of your methods are... unconventional. Care to comment?

subtitle_parts.text: V. Glad you could make it. Lieutenant Mara Voss, NCPD.
I've been going through your recent scanner reports. You've been rather busy.
Some of your methods are... unconventional. Care to comment?

conversation.speaker: v
conversation.text: I wouldn't know. I'm no criminal.
conversation.timing: Conservative initial scene slot; original voice duration/gender variants need game verification

conversation.speaker: voss
conversation.text: Of course not. Let's make sure the paperwork continues to reflect that. I'm investigating a man with connections to Arasaka. A contractor who helped make two witnesses disappear. I had enough evidence to bring him in. Unfortunately, the case was closed before my request for a warrant even reached a judge.

conversation.speaker: v
conversation.text: Guessin' things at the NCPD haven't changed a lick, huh?
conversation.timing: Conservative initial scene slot; original voice duration/gender variants need game verification

conversation.speaker: voss
conversation.text: If anything, corruption's become rather more efficient. The people responsible know exactly which strings to pull. And who's holding the other end.

subtitle_parts.text: If anything, corruption's become rather more efficient.
The people responsible know exactly which strings to pull. And who's holding the other end.

conversation.speaker: v
conversation.text: There even a single clean badge in this city?
conversation.timing: Conservative initial scene slot; original voice duration/gender variants need game verification

conversation.speaker: voss
conversation.text: A few of us, yes. Unfortunately, being honest doesn't make you particularly influential in this department. The contractor is carrying an encrypted data shard. Transaction records, names, dates. Enough to connect him to the disappearances. I need that shard, V. But there's something else. I need you to eliminate him. Permanently. This isn't an arrest. I'm asking you to do wet work.

conversation.speaker: voss
conversation.text: He'll be moving through a public area. There may be witnesses, and I can't prevent patrol officers from responding if someone calls in a shooting. But once it's over, I'll do everything in my power to make sure your name disappears from the incident report. I can't promise you a clean escape. Only that I'll do what I can afterward.

conversation.speaker: v
conversation.text: Well, sounds like a suicide run, but done dumber shit than this, so...

conversation.speaker: voss
conversation.text: Good. I'll send you his location. Retrieve the shard before anyone else gets their hands on it. And V? Whatever happens out there, we never had this conversation.
